subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the first CLI surface remain read-only, or should it also receive authority to resolve pending exec approvals?
rationale: Listing uses an existing operator-scoped read boundary, while resolving requests can authorize command execution and materially expands this issue's security and product scope.

options.title: Land read-only listing first
options.body: Ship pending/list with table and JSON output through `exec.approval.list`, and evaluate resolution authority separately with live authorization proof.

options.title: Include resolution commands
options.body: Accept pending/list plus resolve/respond only after confirming the intended operator scope, decision aliases, audit behavior, and live Gateway authorization path.

recommendation.title: Land read-only listing first
recommendation.body: Ship pending/list with table and JSON output through `exec.approval.list`, and evaluate resolution authority separately with live authorization proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing candidate from the approvals CLI history and the prior issue review.
